sloka: इति वाक्यान्तरे तस्य करालः कृष्णपिङ्गलः ।वामनो विकटो मुण्डी नन्दी प्रह्वभुजो बली ।। ७.१६.८ ॥
transliteration: iti vākyāntare tasya karālaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ ।vāmano vikaṭo muṇḍī nandī prahvabhujo balī ।। 7.16.8 ॥

translations.english: Just as Maricha was speaking, a formidable, black and tawny, dwarfish, monstrous, bald-headed, powerful being named Nandi, with bowed arms, appeared.
